description: Restore the compact Lorelum Installed Pack Catalog at WorkBuddy session boundaries and carry session identity through Bash tool calls.

hooks.command: if output="$(lore hook workbuddy || lore.cmd hook workbuddy)"; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; else printf '%s\n' '{"continue":true}'; fi
if output="$(lore hook workbuddy || lore.cmd hook workbuddy)" && [ "$output" != '{"continue":true}' ]; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; else printf '%s\n' '{}'; fi
